decisions.reason: The shop relaunch SEO service has had its own page for two years. It ties directly into the firm's core relaunch business, so it is a visible, low-cost, central offering that management would keep rather than write off.

The SEO workshops were launched only in 2024 and are publicly presented on their own page. Weak early results can still be attributed to the start-up phase, and the offering fits the firm's announced marketing competence, so management would persist with it.
